flags.reason: The guide and its evidence were checked on 21 October on 0.1.78-c7d3348 and not re-checked on the installed build, dbe0e02, which changed CcCard for #364: badges are Small and benefit icons purple by default, benefits sit 4 px apart, the upsell is a 12 px line, compact shows a 42 px Avatar (the image in a circle, or a “CC” monogram), the full card shows no picture box without imageSource, '' or null hides a footer line, showHeader and showNudge also hide a custom header or upsell, and the full card is 343 × 244. This entry follows the installed package and leaves out the guide sentences dbe0e02 contradicts: Sizing “and 12 px between benefits” and “It comes out taller than Figma’s, because its badges are bigger and its benefits further apart.”; Configuration “AppearanceBrand Secondary turns the benefit icons purple”, “Badge Size Small makes the badges smaller”, their example captions and “Without the badges, 31 px shorter.” (24 px now); the Don’t caption “An empty box still takes its space beside the title.”; Content “an empty headline, description, or footerSubtitle shows its placeholder word”; and the Sources note’s 264 px, Medium badges, 12 px benefits, gold icons, 14 px upsell, 88 × 54 compact picture and hard-coded badge label colour. The guide fix belongs to #364 (open; a work note there lists these sentences). Re-extract once #364 is closed and the guide is re-checked on dbe0e02 and published. Added by Claude Code in the overnight run agentpack-batch11, for Marcin to confirm.

rules.text: Set title yourself on the full card: left out, it shows the sample word “Title” (compact drops the title).
Set subtitle yourself on the full card: left out, it shows the sample word “Subtitle” (compact drops it).
Unless footer replaces the footer text, set headline yourself: left out, it shows the sample word “Headline”; '' or null hides the line.
Unless footer replaces the footer text, set description yourself: left out, it shows the sample word “Description”; '' or null hides the line.
Unless footer replaces the footer text, set footerSubtitle yourself: left out, it shows the sample word “Subtitle”; '' or null hides the line.
Set buttonLabel whenever the card shows its button: it defaults to “Button”.
Set items yourself on the full card: left out, it shows three sample benefit rows (compact drops the benefits).
On the full card, unless header replaces the header, set badges, or hide the header with showHeader false: left out, it shows two sample badges (compact drops the header).
On the full card, unless nudge replaces the upsell, set nudgeSegments, or hide the upsell with showNudge false: left out, it shows the sample “Upsell message JioFinance+” (compact drops the upsell).
Make the title the card's name, short enough for one line, and the subtitle the kind of card.

examples.purpose: Card offers on the Cards screen, the guide's In context: a title, then two full cards one under another, each with its picture, name, benefits and fee; the first adds a trailing badge and an upsell, the second hides the upsell. Each Apply starts the screen's own application through onButtonPress (the empty handlers stand for that wiring). Badges take their colours as modes, as the guide sets them; the upsell's last run is brand-coloured as in the package's own sample. The require() paths stand for the app's own pictures.
examples.jsx:
<VStack>
  <Title title="Cards for you" subtitle="Pre-approved offers" />
  <CcCard
    imageSource={require('./credit-card.png')}
    title="JioFinance Gold Credit Card"
    subtitle="Rewards on gold and every spend"
    badges={[{ label: 'Pre-approved', modes: { AppearanceBrand: 'Tertiary' } }]}
    trailingBadges={[{ label: 'Lifetime free', modes: { AppearanceBrand: 'Secondary' } }]}
    items={[
      { icon: 'ic_rupee_coin', title: '5% back as JioPoints on gold' },
      { icon: 'ic_flight_mode', title: '4 airport lounge visits a year' },
      { icon: 'ic_gift', title: 'No annual fee in the first year' },
    ]}
    nudgeSegments={[{ text: 'Get 2x JioPoints with ' }, { text: 'JioFinance+', modes: { 'Text Appearance': 'Primary' } }]}
    nudgeAvatarSource={require('./jiofinance-logo.png')}
    headline="Joining fee"
    description="₹499"
    footerSubtitle="+ GST"
    buttonLabel="Apply"
    onButtonPress={() => {}}
  />
  <CcCard
    imageSource={require('./credit-card.png')}
    title="JioFinance Everyday Credit Card"
    subtitle="Cashback on bills and groceries"
    badges={[{ label: 'Pre-approved', modes: { AppearanceBrand: 'Tertiary' } }]}
    items={[
      { icon: 'ic_voucher_cashback', title: '2% cashback on bills' },
      { icon: 'ic_wallet', title: '1% cashback on everything else' },
    ]}
    showNudge={false}
    headline="Joining fee"
    description="₹0"
    footerSubtitle="Lifetime free"
    buttonLabel="Apply"
    onButtonPress={() => {}}
  />
</VStack>

props.name: compact
props.description: Compact variant. Renders a 42 px Avatar (Figma) in the media slot and the footer **without** its CTA button. Drops the product title/subtitle, header, list, and nudge — see the MDX. Mirrors the Figma `compact` property. Default false, from the component source.

props.name: showHeader
props.description: Toggles the header badge row. Defaults to `true`. Default true, from the component source.

props.name: badges
props.description: Left out, the header shows two sample Tertiary badges. Declared: Leading (left) badge group.

props.name: trailingBadges
props.description: Trailing (right-aligned) badge group.

props.name: header
props.description: Full override for the header. Takes precedence over `badges`/`trailingBadges`.

props.name: imageSource
props.description: Image source for the default media slot. Accepts a URL string or any RN `ImageSourcePropType`. Ignored when `media` is provided.

props.name: imageWidth
props.description: Default media image width. Defaults to the Figma spec (`88`). Default 88, from the component source.

props.name: imageHeight
props.description: Default media image height. Defaults to the Figma spec (`54`). Default 54, from the component source.

props.name: title
props.description: Product title rendered next to the media slot (non-compact only). Default "Title", from the component source.

props.name: subtitle
props.description: Product subtitle rendered below the title (non-compact only). Default "Subtitle", from the component source.

props.name: media
props.description: Full override for the media slot's visual. Whatever you pass here is rendered **in both the compact and non-compact variants** — e.g. pass an `Avatar` and it stays an avatar in both, pass an `Image` and it stays an image in both. `modes` cascade into it automatically. Defaults to an `Image` driven by `imageSource`.

props.name: items
props.description: A row's icon: null hides its glyph; a row's onPress makes it a button; items={[]} removes the list. Declared: Benefit rows rendered in the list. Defaults to three sample rows.

props.name: showNudge
props.description: Toggles the upsell nudge row. Defaults to `true`. Default true, from the component source.

props.name: nudgeSegments
props.description: Declarative content for the nudge's inline text. Defaults to a sample "Upsell message JioFinance+" string with the last run brand-coloured.

props.name: nudgeAvatarSource
props.description: Avatar image source shown at the start of the nudge row.

props.name: nudge
props.description: Full override for the nudge row. Takes precedence over the declarative props.

props.name: headline
props.description: Small muted label above the footer title (`ccCard/headline/*`). Omit for the sample "Headline". Pass `''` or `null` to hide the line.

props.name: description
props.description: Bold footer value (`ccCard/title/*`). Omit for the sample "Description". Pass `''` or `null` to hide the line.

props.name: footerSubtitle
props.description: Muted caption rendered inline after the description (`ccCard/subtitle/*`). Omit for the sample "Subtitle". Pass `''` or `null` to hide the line.

props.name: footer
props.description: Full override for the footer text block.

props.name: buttonLabel
props.description: CTA button label. Defaults to `"Button"`. Default "Button", from the component source.

props.name: onButtonPress
props.description: CTA press handler.

props.name: button
props.description: Full override for the CTA. Takes precedence over `buttonLabel`.

props.name: showButton
props.description: Hiding the button doesn't change the card's height. Declared: Toggles the CTA button (non-compact). Defaults to `true`. Default true, from the component source.

props.name: onPress
props.description: Makes the card a Pressable named by accessibilityLabel or, without one, its title, slightly dimmed while pressed; with the Apply button kept, that nests a button in a button. There is no disabled. Declared: Press handler for the whole card. When set, the card becomes pressable.

props.name: width
props.description: Card width. Defaults to the Figma spec (`343`). Pass `'100%'` to fill the parent. Default 343, from the component source.

props.name: modes
props.description: Modes object for design-token resolution. Cascaded to all children.

props.name: style
props.description: Style overrides for the card container.

props.name: accessibilityLabel
props.description: Accessibility label for the card.

props.name: CcCardListItem.icon
props.description: Registry icon name for the leading glyph. Defaults to `'ic_card'`. Pass `null` to omit the leading icon. A field of each items row.

props.name: CcCardListItem.iconColor
props.description: Per-row override for the leading icon color. A field of each items row.

props.name: CcCardListItem.leading
props.description: Full override for the leading node. Takes precedence over `icon`. A field of each items row.

props.name: CcCardListItem.title
props.description: Row title (e.g. `"4 domestic + 2 intl. lounge access yearly"`). A field of each items row.

props.name: CcCardListItem.onPress
props.description: Makes the row pressable. A field of each items row.
